# Breez Technology

> Breez builds SDKs that let developers integrate instant, non-custodial bitcoin and stablecoins into any app or service, so value moves as easily as information.

## Products

- [Breez SDK](https://breez.technology/sdk/): The easiest way for developers to add instant, non-custodial bitcoin and stablecoins to any app or service, bringing value transfer to billions
- [Glow](https://breez.technology/glow/): A bitcoin app for everyone — everyday payments in bitcoin or USD, built in the open on the Breez SDK. Download it, fork it, make it your own.
- [SDK Playground](https://breez.technology/playground/): Open-source reference apps built with the Breez SDK — starting points for developers to explore the future of bitcoin UX

## Case Studies

- [Case Studies](https://breez.technology/case-studies/): How developers integrate instant, non-custodial bitcoin and stablecoins using the Breez SDK, with real-world case studies from apps and services worldwide
- [Deblock](https://breez.technology/case-studies/deblock/): Instant, non-custodial bitcoin in a neobank serving 300,000 users across Europe
- [Cake Wallet](https://breez.technology/case-studies/cake/): Instant, non-custodial bitcoin for 1.75 million users globally
- [Primal](https://breez.technology/case-studies/primal/): The most popular Nostr client replaced its custodial wallet, migrating 20K+ users in 30 days
- [Garden](https://breez.technology/case-studies/garden/): A 120x reduction in settlement time for cross-chain bitcoin bridging
- [Exolix](https://breez.technology/case-studies/exolix/): Integrated the Breez SDK in a day for instant, non-custodial bitcoin swaps
- [Klever](https://breez.technology/case-studies/klever/): Lightning-fast, non-custodial bitcoin for 100,000+ users across a multi-chain wallet
- [Sorted](https://breez.technology/case-studies/sorted/): Instant, non-custodial bitcoin on feature phones — 500K+ downloads across 160 countries
- [Club Orange](https://breez.technology/case-studies/cluborange/): The largest bitcoin-only social network moved its community to instant, non-custodial bitcoin
- [Yolat](https://breez.technology/case-studies/yolat/): 10x transaction volume growth with lightning-fast cross-border remittances across Africa

- [Breez SDK - Liquid Documentation](https://sdk-doc-liquid.breez.technology/): Developer documentation for Breez SDK - Liquid, the implementation built on the Liquid Network
- [GitHub](https://github.com/breez): Breez open-source repositories
- [The Bitcoin Payments Report](https://breez.technology/report/): How bitcoin is evolving from digital gold to everyday currency, with data on 650M+ users and real-world case studies
- [Vision](https://breez.technology/vision/): Value transfer moves value as easily as information — directly, instantly, without intermediaries. Breez is building it on bitcoin.
- [llms-full.txt](https://breez.technology/llms-full.txt): Expanded reference — full positioning, SDK feature list, Glow features, and case study details in one file
